title: Tile swirl
summary: A breaks into tiles that lift and swirl in a wave, flipping over in flight to land as B.
signature: tileSwirl(a, b, p, { cols, rows, lift, perspective })

params.name: lift
params.description: lift toward the camera in px

notes: A breaks into tiles that lift and swirl outward in a diagonal wave, flipping over in flight, and land as B.
Stack A and B in one positioned slot (their parent); give the slot overflow:hidden to keep travel inside it.
Pass the real duration in seconds and call it through p = 1: that is when it hides the layers it made.
Draws live copies of the card: a Paper shader canvas inside comes out blank.
